title: Locate and Identify Settings Heading Component
description: Find the React component that renders the 'Settings' heading on the dashboard page and identify the current styling implementation.
details: Search for the 'Settings' text within the app/dashboard/ directory, most likely in app/dashboard/page.tsx or a related component. Examine the JSX structure to identify whether it's a standard HTML heading element (h1, h2) or part of a shadcn/ui component. Document the current Tailwind CSS classes applied to understand the baseline styling before making changes.
test_strategy: Manual inspection of the codebase and running the application locally to visually confirm the current heading appearance and location.

title: Update Heading Font Size with Tailwind CSS
description: Modify the Tailwind CSS utility classes to increase the font size of the Settings heading while maintaining responsive design.
details: Update the className attribute of the identified heading element by changing the current text size utility (e.g., from text-3xl to text-4xl or text-5xl). Ensure the new size aligns with the project's typography scale defined in tailwind.config.ts. Implement responsive classes if needed (e.g., 'text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl') to prevent layout issues on smaller screens. Verify that the change doesn't conflict with existing spacing or layout components.
test_strategy: Test the visual change across different viewport sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile) and verify the heading appears correctly in both light and dark theme modes.

title: Validate Layout and Accessibility
description: Ensure the larger heading maintains proper layout integrity and meets accessibility standards across all supported devices and themes.
details: Test the updated heading on various screen sizes to confirm no layout disruption occurs. Verify that vertical spacing, margins, and overall page composition remain intact. Check color contrast ratios to ensure the larger heading still meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards in both light and dark modes. If layout issues arise, adjust margin/padding utilities as needed. Confirm the heading hierarchy remains semantically correct and doesn't negatively impact screen reader navigation.
test_strategy: Manual testing across multiple viewport sizes, theme modes, and accessibility validation using browser developer tools or accessibility testing extensions.
